controller.git_scan_boundary: SQLite list and detail reads do not scan Git; refreshProjectMetadata and other explicit discovery operations may scan.
controller.singleton_lock: Exclusive owner lock file with live-PID detection and token-checked release; covered by 2 unit tests.
controller.runtime_removal: Transactional DELETE FROM projects after remote-request cancellation; runtime-owned rows cascade, so knowledge must reference an independent project and only detach its mapping.

resource_contract.source_worktree: clean main worktree at the same source commit
